xAI announced Grok Voice 3.0 on October 14, 2026, as a speech-to-speech model for real-time voice agents.

**Launch and availability:** The model went out through xAI's Voice Agent API on that date, under the model ID grok-voice-3.0. It replaces Grok Voice 2.0 as the default behind the Voice Agent API. The grok-voice-latest alias now points to this release, and xAI documents Grok Voice 2.0 as deprecated. Developers can connect through a WebSocket endpoint, and that API matches the shape of OpenAI's Realtime API.

**What it is:** Unlike pipelines that chain speech-to-text, a language model, and text-to-speech, this model processes and responds in audio directly. xAI aimed it at phone support, contact centers, and in-app assistants.

**Performance claims:** xAI says the model has under one second of latency. According to xAI's announcement, Artificial Analysis independently tested Grok Voice 3.0 and ranked it #1 on the Speech-to-Speech Index with a score of 86.9. xAI also cites a 97.0% score on Full Duplex Bench, a turn-taking evaluation, and a 74% accuracy figure on EVA-Bench.

**Pricing:** xAI held the price flat at $0.08 per minute while retiring its predecessor.

**Deployments:** xAI says the model already runs in Tesla vehicles and in SpaceX's Starlink customer support. One report says Starlink's support line handles about 20,000 calls a day and already handles several million conversations a day across Tesla in-car controls and Starlink's customer support.

**Caveats:** The benchmark figures come from xAI's own announcement. No separate public Artificial Analysis leaderboard page for Grok Voice 3.0 has been confirmed yet, so these scores shouldn't be treated as independently confirmed until a third party publishes its own entry. The Starlink and Tesla usage figures are also company-reported. The sources I found agree on the launch date, pricing, and API details, but the deployment numbers vary between outlets.

I found no evidence of a Nemotron 3.5 release in October 2026. The results point to an August 11, 2026 launch of Nemotron 3.5 Lightning. One source says it's the first text LLM in the Nemotron 3.5 generation, a 30B total / 3B active model with up to 1M context.

**Launch details (August 2026)**
- NVIDIA launched it alongside NeMo Switchyard, an open-source library that automatically routes requests to the most suitable AI model.
- The model is a mixture-of-experts model with 30 billion parameters, aimed at specific tasks within larger multi-agent systems.
- NVIDIA says it is up to 4x faster output and 30% faster agentic task completion than competing models in its class. These are NVIDIA's own claims.
- It is released under the OpenMDW License Agreement, version 1.1, and allows commercial use and modification with no licensing fee.
- Hardware needs vary. The NVFP4 repository is approximately 21.6GB before runtime overhead and context-cache allocation are considered.

DeepSeek released V4.1 Flash on September 10, 2026, according to several outlets. Some sources also describe a limited beta a couple of days earlier.

**Release and availability**
- The model replaced V4 Flash and V4 Flash Vision Experimental, and it cut API prices. The new model became available on September 10, 2026, under the API name deepseek-flash.
- Earlier beta coverage differs on naming. One report says DeepSeek V4.1 Flash began a limited beta on September 8, 2026, and that beta ran under a test name, deepseek-v4.1-flash-expires-on-0910. The official launch sources point to the deepseek-flash name instead.
- Weights were published on Hugging Face under the MIT license. The Hangzhou lab announced it in a thread on X and published the weights on Hugging Face under the MIT licence, which lets anyone download, modify and run it.

**Architecture and specs**
- V4.1-Flash has 552 billion parameters in total. It activates 8 billion parameters per token when reading input and 16 billion when writing output.
- The model handles up to 1 million tokens of context and understands images natively, according to its model card. Output can reach up to 384,000 tokens.
- Vision works differently from the earlier Flash variant. Unlike the V4-Flash-Vision-Exp released on August 21, which attached a vision extension pack to the text model, V4.1 Flash integrates multimodal capabilities directly into the model architecture itself.

**Related change: V4-Pro retirement**
- From 04:00 UTC on 14 September, DeepSeek will send every request made to V4-Pro, its top model, to V4.1-Flash instead. That arrangement runs until a V4.1-Pro arrives. DeepSeek gave no date for it.

**Performance claims**
- DeepSeek says the model beats its own flagship on coding and agent tasks. Independent verification is lacking: one report notes that none are independently verified.

**Pricing**
- OpenRouter lists $0.30/M input tokens and $1.20/M output tokens, with separate rates for Cache Read at $0.006/M tokens. Third-party provider pricing may differ.

Meta released Muse Wonder on October 12, 2026, through its Superintelligence Lab. It comes in two versions, Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, and Meta calls them its most capable models so far. The models are designed to handle demanding personal and professional tasks.

**Access and availability**
- The standard model is available through Meta's API. The model ID is muse-wonder-1.0, and it is still labeled a preview. It is on the Meta Model API, on OpenRouter, and inside every Muse Code plan. The model is still labelled a preview on the API.
- Wonder Full is limited to subscribers. One source says it is only in the Muse Code Power ($50/month) and Max ($200/month) plans.
- Meta says Muse Wonder will reach its consumer app in stages. It will initially roll out to subscribers and later help create specialised models for broader Muse experiences. One report says the Muse app still runs on Spark 1.3 for now.

**Capabilities and pricing**

Ось три найважливіші релізи за 11–18 жовтня 2026 року:

1. **Meta Muse Wonder 1.0 (12 жовтня)**: лабораторія Meta Superintelligence Lab випустила дві моделі, Muse Wonder і Muse Wonder Full, які компанія називає своїми найпотужнішими; вони приймають текст, зображення, відео, аудіо та PDF і мають контекст близько 1 млн токенів. Базова версія доступна через API у статусі preview, а Full лише за платною підпискою. Джерела: [Euronews](https://es.euronews.com/2026/10/13/meta-lanza-muse-wonder-sus-modelos-de-ia-mas-potentes-hasta-ahora), [YourStory](https://yourstory.com/ai-story/muse-wonder-meta-ai-race-frontier-models)

2. **Meta Muse Spark Open (15 жовтня)**: Meta називає цю модель найпотужнішою моделлю з відкритими вагами у США; вона має 816 млрд параметрів і контекст 1 млн токенів, а найкраще працює локально на Mac Studio з чипом M5 Ultra. Джерело: [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/15/meta-launches-an-open-weight-model-that-runs-on-macs/)

3. **xAI Grok Voice 3.0 (14 жовтня)**: xAI випустила модель, яка розпізнає мовлення й одразу відповідає голосом, для голосових агентів у реальному часі, із затримкою менше секунди; вона замінила Grok Voice 2.0 у Voice Agent API, а ціна лишилася $0,08 за хвилину. Джерело: [DevX](https://www.devx.com/artificial-intelligence-ai/what-is-grok-voice-3-0-xai-speech-to-speech-model/)

Що варто знати про ці дані:
- Результати бенчмарків і показники продуктивності в усіх трьох випадках подали самі компанії, незалежно їх ще не перевірили.
- Один агрегатор вказує DeepSeek V4.1 Flash «1017» з датою 17 жовтня, але оновлення в цю дату я не знайшов; модель вийшла 10 вересня, тому до списку я її не включив.
- Claude Haiku 5.5 (7 жовтня) і Mistral Large 4 (6 жовтня) вийшли раніше, ніж 7 днів тому.
